summary: Washington Post : Sources: Pete Hegseth and other Pentagon officials discussed using the Defense Production Act as leverage to pressure Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang — The Cold War-era Defense Production Act gives presidents extraordinary power to intervene in the economy.
